senses.gloss:
धव् धव् (connected with rts. 1. धाव्
and धन्व्), cl. 1. A. धवते, &c., Ved.
to run, flow; [cf. Gr. θέ-ω, θεύσομαι, θοός, βοη-θέ-ω,
νω-θής.].

धाव् 1. धाव् (connected with rts. धव्
and धन्व्), cl. 1. P. and sometimes
A. धावति, -ते, दधाव, -ए, धाविष्यति, -ते,
अधावीत्, अधाविष्ट, धावितुम्, to flow, stream or
flow forth, flow towards; to give milk (as a cow);
to run, proceed quickly, advance, run away, run
towards, advance against; to rush against, assault;
run a race; run away, flee; to go, move, glide:
Caus. धावयति, &c., Aor. अदीधवत्, to cause to
run, make run, drive, impel, push on; धावयति
रथेन, he drives in a chariot: Desid. दिधावि-
षति, -ते: Intens. दाधाव्यते: [cf. Gr. θέ-ω, θεύ-σομαι,
θο-ό-ς, θοάζ-ω, βοη-θό-ος; Hib. deifir, ‘haste.’]

धाव् 2. धाव्, cl. 1. P. A. धावति, -ते,
दधाव, -ए, धाविष्यति, -ते, अधावीत्,
अधाविष्ट, धावितुम्, to rub, rub off, cleanse,
clean, wash, purify, polish, brighten, make pure or
bright; A. to rub one's self with anything, to rub into
one's person: Caus. धावयति, &c., Aor. अदी-
धवत्, to cleanse, wash: Desid. दिधाविषति, -ते:
Intens. दाधाव्यते; [cf. probably Goth. daupya
= Old Sax. dopyu = Mod. Germ. taufe, ‘I baptize,’
= Caus. धावयामि.]

धव 1. धव, अस्, m. the plant Grislea
Tomentosa (= मधुर-त्वच).

धव 2. धव, अस्, m. (said by some to be
fr. rt. 1. धू?), a man; a husband [cf. स-धवा
and वि-धवा]; a possessor, master, lord; a rogue,
a cheat; N. of a Vasu (probably incorrect for
धर).

धाव, अस्, आ, अम्, cleansing, washing, making
bright, polishing, (at the end of an adj. comp.; cf.
चैल-ध्˚ and असि-ध्˚.)

धवनी धवनी, f. a kind of plant, Desmo-
dium Gangeticum or a similar species.

धावनि, इस्, ई, f. a sort of creeping plant, Hedy-
sarum Lagopodioides.

धवर धवर, अम्, n. a particular high
number.

धवल धवल, अस्, आ, अम् (said to be fr. rt.
2. धाव्), white, dazzling white, of a shining white
colour; handsome, beautiful; (अस्), m. white (the
colour); an old bull, an excellent ox; a kind of
camphor (= चीन-कर्पूर); the plant Grislea To-
mentosa (= धव); N. of one of the elephants of
the quarters; N. of a Rāga or mode of music,
(according to Bharata, the eighth son of Hindola-
rāga); (आ or ई), f. a white cow; (ई), f. a kind of
disease (perhaps only whiteness of the hair); N. of
a river; (अम्), n. white pepper; a kind of metre
consisting of 4 × 18 short syllables and 1 long (=
धवलाङ्क; cf. उदय-ध्˚).
—धवल-गिरि,
इस्, m. ‘the white or snowy mountain’ (commonly
dhoula-giri or dola-gir), N. of one of the highest
peaks of the great snowy range of the Himālayas,
lat. 29. 11, long. 82. 59.
—धवल-गृह, अम्, n.
a house whitened with chunam or stucco, a palace.
—धवल-त्व, अम्, n. whiteness.
—धवल-
पक्ष, अस्, m. ‘white-winged,’ a goose; the light
[]
half of the month, the fortnight of the moon's in-
crease.
—धवल-पुराण-समुच्चय, अस्, m., N.
of a work.
—धवल-मृत्तिका, f. ‘white earth,’
chalk.
—धवल-यावनाल, अस्, m. white Yāvanāla.
—धवलाङ्क (˚ल-अङ्˚), अम्, n. = धवल, a
species of the Ati-dhṛti metre.
—धवली-कृत, अस्,
आ, अम्, made white, whitened, whited.
—धवली-
भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, become white.
—धवलोत्पल
(˚ल-उत्˚), अम्, n. the white esculent water-lily.

धवलित, अस्, आ, अम्, made dazzling white,
whitened, white.
धवलिमन्, आ, m. whiteness, white colour, white.

धवाणक धवाणक, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 1. धू),
air, wind.
धवितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. to be fanned.

धवित्र, अम्, n. a Paṅkhā or fan (made of ante-
lope's skin or leather, and used especially for blowing
a sacrificial fire).

1. धावक, अस्, आ, अम्, running, flowing, going
quickly, running in advance, expeditious; (अस्), m.,
N. of an author in the pay of king Śrī-harṣa; (also
read भासक; he is said to have composed the
Ratnāvalī for Śrī-harṣa.)

धावक, अस्, आ, अम्, washing, cleansing; (अस्),
m. a washerman, a dhobī.

धावत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, running, going quickly,
running away.

1. धावन, अम्, n. running, galloping, flowing,
moving; attack, assault; (अस्), m., N. of a spell for
using or restraining magical weapons.

2. धावन, अम्, n. rubbing off, washing off, cleans-
ing, purifying; rubbing with anything, (in comp.,
e. g. मीन-धावन-तोय, मनःशिला-चन्दन-
ध्˚, q. v.)
धावमान, अस्, आ, अम्, running, going quickly.

1. धावित, अस्, आ, अम्, running, running off or
away; running towards, advanced against.
2. धावित, अस्, आ, अम्, purified, cleansed, clean.
धावितृ, ता, m. a runner; running.
धाविन्, ई, इनी, इ, running, going quickly.

धावनिका, f. a kind of prickly nightshade, =
कण्ट-कारिका.

धावल्य धावल्य, अम्, n. (fr. धवल),
whiteness, white (the colour).
